name: Las Estampitas
medium: rendered HTML + Canvas2D, screenshot at 1440x900 — no image model available this session
fixed_across_comps: Gauchito red as the committed carrier
candle-warm key; the visitor carries the light
celeste withheld from the entire palette until a release is earned
Chivo for engraved plaque capitals, Alegreya for votive text
must_not_literalize: plaque copy and dates are real and load-bearing, but their placement is compositional, not a layout spec
the offering and plaque counts are illustrative of proportion, not final content
image slots are deliberately empty or marked SIN IMAGEN — the image ladder is undecided by the user's choice
risk: Without a wall or a mass it can read as floating cards in space.
approved_note: Chosen by Juan 2026-08-31 over La Pared and El Arbol. Carries the strongest answer to 'no fixed order' and is already shaped for the undecided image ladder. Named risk to solve in the build: the sparse opening is the one most exposed to 'reverence that reads as cold', which he listed as a failure condition.
prompt: El Santuario, first viewport, desktop 1440x900. No wall and no centre. Votive panels suspended at different depths in a dark volume, near ones sharp and legible, far ones blurred and dim, movement possible in any direction. Three panels forward: a tin TE PIDO Maracana 13-VII-2014, a brass GRACIAS POR EL FAVOR CONCEDIDO Maracana 10-VII-2021 as the single focal element, and a tin panel whose image slot reads SIN IMAGEN. Red ribbons fall softly out of focus behind. One line of Alegreya italic, 'acercate'. Chivo engraved capitals. Celeste absent.
